outcome: leukocyte counts (monocytes, neutrophils, eosinophils, immature granulocytes)
cohort: The study included newborns from 23 pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia (11 EOPE, 12 LOPE) and 195 controls (153 uncomplicated, 23 fetal growth restriction, 19 preterm birth) from The Rotterdam Periconceptional Cohort.
finding: Early-onset preeclampsia (EOPE) is associated with derangements in fetal hematopoiesis, specifically decreased neutrophil and increased nucleated red blood cell counts, while late-onset preeclampsia (LOPE) shows no significant associations.
